zh-CN.title: QQ 来源标识焕新
items: 尚未认领的 QQ 用户改用双区来源签，与等级和认证标识更易区分
评论中的 QQ 提及同步采用紧凑方签，在深浅主题下都更清晰

en.title: Refined QQ source labels
items: Unclaimed QQ users now use a split source label that is easier to distinguish from levels and verification badges
QQ mentions now use a compact matching marker with clearer contrast in light and dark themes
